description: Read a paginated list of crawl page results by task id (the latest attempt's unless attemptId is given). Pages omit the routing audit and trace unless debug is true, and leave out pages whose content repeated an earlier page's (status duplicate) unless includeDuplicates is true. With maxResults the tool follows cursors itself, up to that many pages, and answers { items, nextCursor, hasMore, stoppedBy }.

includeDuplicates.description: List the pages whose body repeated an earlier page's too (status duplicate, markdown null). Default false.

maxResults.description: Follow cursors from cursor on and return up to this many pages in all, each request no larger than what is still wanted; nextCursor then continues exactly after the last page returned, and stoppedBy says whether the end or this cap stopped the listing.

name: get_crawl_pages

stoppedBy.description: size: the answer reached its size budget; read on from nextCursor.

title: Get crawl pages
